runs.prompt:
Draw this as an SVG, as close to a photo as you can.

A portrait-orientation photo of a scruffy, black and grey dog standing on wet golden sand at the beach on a sunny day. The dog faces the camera, with its head turned slightly towards the left of the frame. It has a white muzzle and grey whiskers, a big black nose, brown eyes, one ear pricked up and one flopped over, and its mouth is open in a happy pant with a long pink tongue hanging out. It wears a red collar with a small round red tag, and has a white patch on its chest. Its legs are long and thin, the front-left paw is white, and the paws are slightly blurred. Its shadow stretches away to the right across the sand. Behind it, white foamy waves wash up the shore, then a band of teal-green sea meets a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds.
runs.system: Return a complete, self-contained SVG document.
